data.author: MuchElk2597
data.body: The key difference, as explained in the announcement thoroughly, is that this framework allows inter-process communication between agents, rather than all communication having to happen via the orchestrator agent. In other words, all of the engineers could only talk to each other by talking to the boss, and the boss would tell the other engineers. Now the engineers can talk directly with each other and pluck tasks off a shared queue
